lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.
Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh marai na kaal na khaae guramukh sach samaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai kul sagale taare guramukh janam savaaraniaa ||3||
lines.translation: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh dukh kade na lagai sareer ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.
The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh man niramal phir mail na laagai guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||
The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.
The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee guramukh sabad karaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.
The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh gun gaavai sadaa niramal sabade bhagat karaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||
Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.
Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin rogee bisataa ke keeRe bisataa mahi dukh paavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||
The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.
In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||25||26||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The One Light is the light of all bodies.
The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape pharak keeton ghat a(n)tar aape banat banaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo ko sahaj na paae guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape sohahi aape jag mohahi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.
You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape dukh sukh devahi karate guramukh har dekhaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||
The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.
Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabade upajai a(n)mrit baanee guramukh aakh sunaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa mukat aape hai sachaa aape alakh lakhaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||
He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.
He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape gunadaataa gun gaavai aape aakh sunaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||
He Himself acts, and causes others to act.
He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hovai too(n) aape kaarai laavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||
He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.
He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||
